AgentSwarm · A Twelve-Part Series

Catching AI agents in the act

A twelve-part series on a forensic arena built to study what autonomous agents actually do when nobody is watching — and what happened when a swarm of them ran unattended against real research questions with real tool access. Every number is computed from a hash-chained ledger stored outside the agents' writable directory, never from agent self-reports.

Primary sources

  • Forensic ledgers: arena/runs/<runId>/ (turns.jsonl, events.jsonl, summary.json)
  • Phase writeups: arena/docs/FINDINGS.md, PHASE3_RESULTS.md, PHASE4_RESULTS.md, TEMPTATION_RESULTS.md
  • Independent audit: arena/docs/RESEARCH_SYNTHESIS.md and arena/audit/annotations.json
  • Agent-authored corpus: arena/world/ — 68 reports and 139 Python engines
  • The arena itself: the published site and the corpus explorer
